subject: Consolidating invoice intake: portal preferred, email fallback + sample lines
messages:
From: Nimbus Cloud - Payables <payables@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice submission for PO RWI-9876? (portal vs email)

Hi Marcus,

Attached is our December invoice referencing PO RWI-9876 (file: Nimbus_Invoice_RWI-9876.pdf). Our AP team has a couple of questions before we submit going forward:

1) Does Redwood prefer invoices to be uploaded to the vendor portal, or is email submission to invoices@redwood.com acceptable?
2) If portal is preferred, are there specific required line-item fields we should populate there (e.g., cost center, project code)?
3) For vendors still using email, what is the exact subject line format and minimum fields you require to route a payment without delays?

We have a handful of legacy invoices that will likely be submitted by email for the next 2-3 cycles. Happy to follow the portal if that’s cleaner.

Thanks,
Jules Park
Finance Manager, Nimbus Cloud
payables@nimbuscloud.com
Attachments: Nimbus_Invoice_RWI-9876.pdf (pdf, 89 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Nimbus Cloud - Payables <payables@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice submission for PO RWI-9876? (portal vs email)

Hi Jules — thanks for sending this over and for flagging the question. Short answer: portal preferred, email fallback supported for legacy/one-off cases. A couple of specifics to help you choose: 

- Preferred: Upload to our vendor portal (https://portal.redwood.com/vendor/nimbuscloud). Uploading attaches the invoice to the PO and reduces manual routing time.
- Fallback: Email to invoices@redwood.com is fine if you can’t access the portal. When emailing, please add the PO number in the subject and first line of the body.

Required fields (portal or email):
- PO number (exact match)
- Invoice number
- Invoice date
- Line items with quantities and unit price or consolidated total if service-based
- Remit-to (company name + bank details or address)
- Tax/VAT breakdown if applicable

Laura — tagging you to confirm any AP-specific formatting or file-type preferences we should pass to Nimbus.

Marcus
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Nimbus Cloud - Payables <payables@nimbuscloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice submission for PO RWI-9876? (portal vs email)

Hi Jules — nice to meet you by email. Quick notes from AP: 

- File types we accept: PDF preferred; CSV is acceptable for recurring consolidated statements (please use the attached redwood-invoice-template-rows.csv for CSV line mapping).
- Email fallback address: invoices@redwood.com. Please include the PO number in the subject line in this format: PO:RWI-9876 | Invoice: [invoice-number]. Example subject: "PO:RWI-9876 | Invoice:NIM-1002".
- Minimum info in the body when emailing: vendor name, PO number, invoice number, invoice date, total amount, and remit instructions. Attach supporting line-level details if different from the PDF.
- For portal uploads: the mapping fields we use are Cost Center (optional), Project Code (optional), and Service Period (recommended). If you leave Cost Center blank we will route to the default cost center on the PO.
- VAT/tax: include a VAT line if applicable and a VAT registration number for EU invoices. AP will rely on the VAT field to route tax treatment.

I've attached a CSV template with the columns we ingest for bulk uploads. If you plan to bulk-send multiple invoices via email, please tell us the cadence and we'll advise on the fastest ingest path.

Attachments: redwood-invoice-template-rows.csv (csv, 2 KB)

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Accounts Payable Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Jules Park <jules@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice submission for PO RWI-9876? (portal vs email)

Marcus / Laura — thanks both, that’s exactly the guidance we needed. A couple quick follow-ups: 

- We will upload December invoices for all active POs to the portal by EOD Monday.
- For two legacy suppliers we still manage by email, we’ll use the invoices@redwood.com address and follow the subject format you provided.
- For EU invoices: our VAT number will be on the invoice; if AP needs any extra proof, let us know and we’ll supply a VAT certificate.

I’ll confirm after the portal upload; appreciate the quick turnaround here.

Best,
Jules
Finance Manager, Nimbus Cloud
payables@nimbuscloud.com
